mintAuthority.summary: Solayer sUSD is minted through the Solayer sUSD Program after USDC/RWA workflow checks. The Token-2022 mint, freeze, interest-rate, and metadata update authorities resolve to a Solayer program-owned authority PDA. The Solayer program remains upgradeable by a plain keypair (EOA-equivalent) upgrade authority.

controls.label: Solayer sUSD Token-2022 mint/freeze/rate authority
controls.evidence: At Solana finalized slot 425792161, getAccountInfo on mint susdabGDNbhrnCa6ncrYo81u4s9GM8ecK2UwMyZiq4X (jsonParsed) confirmed mintAuthority=FhVcYNEe58SMtxpZGnTu2kpYJrTu2vwCZDGpPLqbd2yG and freezeAuthority=FhVcYNEe58SMtxpZGnTu2kpYJrTu2vwCZDGpPLqbd2yG. The authority account is owned by executable program s1aysqpEyZyijPybUV89oBGeooXrR22wMNLjnG2SWJA (Solayer sUSD program).

controls.label: Solayer sUSD program upgrade authority
controls.evidence: At Solana finalized slot 425792161, getAccountInfo on 7671j7qpSf9X5KbQDraXReGK8Dxg5xGjr9n913BWhqru returned owner=11111111111111111111111111111111 (System Program), executable=false, data=empty — confirming a plain keypair (EOA-equivalent), not a multisig or program. This keypair is the BPFUpgradeable upgrade authority for the Solayer sUSD program s1aysqpEyZyijPybUV89oBGeooXrR22wMNLjnG2SWJA.

sources.label: Solayer RFQ stakeholders and cUSDO backing

review.evidence: At Solana finalized slot 425792161: Token-2022 mint authority FhVcYNEe confirmed via getAccountInfo jsonParsed on mint susdabGDNbhrnCa6ncrYo81u4s9GM8ecK2UwMyZiq4X; upgrade authority 7671j7qp confirmed as plain keypair (System Program owned, no data). All mint-capable surfaces resolved. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: a plain-keypair upgrade authority can replace mint logic without an independent timelock, while cUSDO composition disclosures do not reconcile all sUSD supply and no regulator or independent sUSD attestor is evidenced. Solayer's sUSD FAQ documents a continuous transaction-level mint gate: the Solayer sUSD Program issues the sUSD liability only after a qualified liquidity provider supplies a wrapped-T-Bill proof against the user's locked USDC; the Solayer program performs this supply-to-collateral reconciliation on each mint, rather than a named independent examiner.
